fixes.name: Moonkin Form
fixes.text:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party {*or raid*} members within 45 yards have their {~spell~} Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.
The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
fixes.why: raid-wide is new (reworked, not just reworded), and only spell crit now (red: narrower than before)

fixes.name: Leader of the Pack
fixes.text: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the {~melee and ranged Critical Strike~} chance of all party {*or raid*} members within 45 yards by 3%.
fixes.why: raid-wide is new (reworked, not just reworded), and only melee and ranged crit now (red: narrower than before)

fixes.name: Auto Shot
add: Now requires you to stand still for 0.5 sec before shooting, matching early versions of World of Warcraft. You still fire Auto Shot while casting spells like Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot.
fixes.why: 12.1.5 patch notes; not a tooltip change

fixes.name: Summon Hawk
add: Will now correctly cause the Hawk to spawn at the target the spell was cast on, and the Hawk will stick to the target it was summoned on.
